findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account_get_profile, seller_list_listings · Private data: catalog_get_listing, account_get_profile, seller_list_offers, seller_list_sales, support_create_ticket · Public sink: listing_resolve_category, listing_crosslist_draft, account_get_profile, listing_create, listing_add_photos, seller_update_listing, support_create_ticket · Destructive: seller_remove_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: account_get_profile, seller_list_listings · Private data: catalog_get_listing, account_get_profile, seller_list_offers, seller_list_sales, support_create_ticket · Public sink: listing_resolve_category, listing_crosslist_draft, account_get_profile, listing_create, listing_add_photos, seller_update_listing, support_create_ticket · Destructive: seller_remove_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
